in_sanskrit.name: यज्ञिक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: यज् (yaj) + निक (nik) = यज्ञिक (yajnik) = one who performs a sacrifice

in_hindi.long_meaning: यज् (yaj) + क (k) + िक (nik) = यज्ञिक (yajnik) = one who performs a sacrifice

in_tamil.name: யாஜ்னிக்
in_tamil.meaning: ஆய்ச்சிப்பார் (ayyccippar) = one who performs a sacrifice

in_marathi.name: Yagnik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yagnik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A person who performs yajna or sacrifice, a worshiper, a devotee.

in_bengali.name: Yagnik
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sacrifice, Worshipper
